review_independence: This agent authored the API/CLI; root-authored production and replay wrappers were independently reviewed here. This is static review, not independent numerical validation.
scope: Native ordinary-file API/storage compatibility, producer source closure and public CLI replay coverage/shutdown

findings_resolved.resolution: Result source_geometry snapshot uses model/source_geometry/...; nested model descriptor retains source_geometry/...
Producer capsule now includes split_kernel_compensated.py, whose _component and _reject_J are called
Producer explicitly checks the six ordered alias/state pairs
Replay resolves output before launching children with cwd=Git root
Replay attempts terminate on each observed member, waits up to 10 seconds and records remaining observed PIDs; it does not force termination or claim unknown descendants are gone

replay_comparison_contract.array_comparison: All field names, dtypes and values; NPZ file-byte comparisons also bind shapes and signed-zero storage
replay_comparison_contract.result_metadata_comparison: All fields except timing_seconds and its consequent descriptor_sha256; result.json is not claimed byte-identical

limitations: The flat source capsule binds producer/test/viewer/checker bytes; it is not a standalone importable package. Replay requires the complete Git root and ordinary saved inputs.

Python plus the documented NumPy/SciPy/JAX dependencies are required for the force CLI imports; psutil is additionally required by the producer/replay wrappers. No runtime availability or version compatibility was tested here.
Producer uses cooperative elapsed/RSS samples and an external timeout; replay samples the observed child tree. Neither wrapper provides an OS memory hard limit or claims capture of unknown processes.
Cleanup records observed members still alive after its wait; it does not use force termination.
Force counters count submitted evaluator/CLI invocations; on a failure they do not prove how many kernel calls completed.

Numerical producer, HP checker, functionality tests and visualizations require their separate frozen execution and review. This static record does not certify a force result, equilibrium, contact or an H2/H3 study choice.
